notablePrerequisites:
Phyrexian Colossus does not have summoning sickness.
Loxodon Warhammer and Burning Anger attached to Phyrexian Colossus.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Colossus by tapping it, dealing eleven damage to any target and causing you to gain eleven life.
Activate Phyrexian Colossus by paying eight life, untapping it.
Repeat.
